failure_summary.description: Agents skipped ready domains, ignored pending cached-result updates, or repeated completed work despite explicit incremental-cache guidance.
Agents added imports or model/helper definitions, or failed to assign and save results from searches.
Agents changed a requested state/category value or treated a single rating as a minimum rather than an exact rating.

patch.reasoning: The observed errors are already explicitly covered by the skill: use runtime tools without redefining schemas or helpers, save every result-producing call, preserve user values, process pending domains independently, update suitable cached results, and treat an unqualified single rating as exact. No additional edit is warranted without duplicating existing rules.
